purpose: Diagnose the previously observed R0=96, eta=0.7, N=1e6 failure and add m=3 without replacing the retained baseline results.

known_peak_location_assisted_diagnostic.peak_selection: local maximum nearest the noise-free detector peak
known_peak_location_assisted_diagnostic.role: diagnostic only; uses the noiseless peak location but does not fix the noisy peak value, physical branch, or half-height crossing; not experimental feasibility evidence

wide_blind.selection_basis: post-failure alternative chosen using noise-free detector curves only; all four orders retain one peak and deterministic half-height bias remains below 0.007 mm in the R0=96, eta=0.7 diagnostic

event: quadratic peak interpolation and nearest preceding rising half-height crossing
discrete_maximum_comparison: A blind selection is counted as the same discrete local maximum when its selected sample index equals the index selected by the known-peak-location-assisted diagnostic in that realization. This equality is not a physical peak-identity classification.
semantic_label_amendment: The 2026-09-20 audit replaced the misleading oracle-identity label. The peak-selection algorithm, smoothing widths, search window, random seeds, and replicate counts are unchanged.
interval_calibration: Estimate event covariance from the calibration replicates; evaluate fixed normal intervals on independent validation replicates.
